clip.title: Pain's Cycle of Hatred
clip.dialogue:
Naruto: (grunts) Pain: You asked me why I'm {{blank}} all this. But even if I told you why...
...I doubt very strongly that the {{blank}} would change anything at all. But let's say that I take the time to {{blank}} it to you.
What do you think {{blank}} happen then? Naruto: I have nothing to say to you. Pain: My goal is to {{blank}} the dream even Jiraiya-sensei was unable to achieve.
Naruto: (grunts) Pain: As I said earlier... ...what I want is to create {{blank}} and bring about justice.
Naruto: Create peace? Justice? Are you kidding?!? GIVE ME A {{blank}}! You killed my master...
...and my sensei! Hurt my friends... Destroyed my village!!!
After all of the horrible {{blank}} that you've done... ...DON'T YOU DARE TALK ABOUT PEACE AND JUSTICE!
(heavy breathing) Pain: Then tell me...what is your goal?
Naruto: First, I'm {{blank}} kill you! And then, I'M GONNA BRING PEACE TO THE NINJA {{blank}}! Pain: Oh I see. That is noble of you.
That WOULD be justice. However... What about MY family? MY friends?
MY village? They {{blank}} the same fate as this village at the hands of you Hidden Leaf ninja.
How is it fair to let ONLY YOU people {{blank}} about peace and justice?
Naruto: *gasp* What the hell are you {{blank}} about? Pain: Once...the Land of Fire and the {{blank}} Leaf had grown too big.
To protect their national interest, they forced feudal clans to {{blank}} war against each other... ...and profited from it.
Otherwise, the people of the villages would've {{blank}}. As it happened, our little nation and it's villages became the battlefield where the great nations waged their war.
Each time they did... ...our nation was ravaged and laid to {{blank}}. After many such battles, the great nation stabilized...
...but our smaller nations suffered... ...and it {{blank}} recovered. You and I are both {{blank}}the very same thing.
We both want to achieve the peace that Jiraiya-sensei {{blank}}. You and I are the same.
We're both motivated by our desire for peace and justice. The justice that I have {{blank}} against the Leaf village...
...is no different from what you are trying to do to me. Everyone feels the same pain when losing {{blank}} dear.
You and I have BOTH experienced that pain. You strive for your justice... ...and I strive for mine.
We're both just ordinary men... ...who had been {{blank}} to seek vengeance in the name of justice. And...
...if one comes to call vengeance "justice"... ...such "justice" will only breed further vengeance...
...and trigger a vicious "Cycle Of Hatred." Right now, we live in such a {{blank}}.
I know the past and can foretell our future. It is the same...as our history. SO WE BELIEVE THAT HUMAN BEINGS SIMPLY CANNOT UNDERSTAND EACH OTHER...
AND THEY NEVER WILL. The shinobi world of ours is ruled by {{blank}}...
...and hatred alone. Jiraiya: However...
Even I'm able to see... ...that there's entirely too much hate in this shinobi world of ours. Naruto: There's too much hate?
Jiraiya: Ah. I've always wanted to do something about all of this hatred. I'm just not {{blank}} sure how to go about it as of yet.
But I truly believe... ...that eventually, the day will come... ...when all people will understand one another and live in {{blank}}.
Naruto: Boy, it sounds kind of complicated to me. Jiraiya: And if I can't find the solution to this problem... ...then perhaps I'll {{blank}} you to find it instead, eh, Naruto?
Naruto: Yes sir! I can't turn down a request from my master, can I, Pervy Sage?
(quiet grunting) So Naruto... ...how would YOU {{blank}} this hatred in order to create peace?

slides.title: Cause and effect linkers
slides.content:
Pain argues that vengeance breeds vengeance. To make his case he uses cause-and-effect language: structures that link a cause to its consequence.

Notice four patterns in the clip:
• If X, X will only Y  →  conditional consequence
• ...and trigger Y     →  chained result (action triggers result)
• at the hands of...   →  agent of harm (passive blame)
• as a result...       →  explicit cause → effect connector

words.word: If one calls vengeance 'justice', such 'justice' will only breed further vengeance.
words.example: Pattern: If X, X will only Y

words.word: …and trigger a vicious Cycle Of Hatred.
They suffered the same fate as this village at the hands of you Hidden Leaf ninja.
words.example: Pattern: at the hands of X

words.word: As a result, hatred spreads to the next generation.

slides.title: Your turn — free production
slides.prompt: If you were Naruto, how would YOU confront the cycle of hatred and bring peace?
slides.content:
Use at least TWO cause-and-effect linkers from the Language Focus.
Speak for 1-2 minutes (or write 80-120 words).
Reference the scene: Pain, vengeance, the Hidden Leaf, peace.
Then explain whether you agree with Pain or with Naruto, and why.
